scripts.test-interactive: tsc --watch & echo "browse to: http://localhost:8080/tests-interactive/" && http-server -c-1 && fg
scripts.build: npm run copy-lib && npm run copy-index && npm run copy-resources && tsc
scripts.build-with-data: npm run copy-lib && npm run copy-data && npm run copy-index && npm run copy-resources && tsc
scripts.copy-lib: mkdir -p dist/source/lib && cp node_modules/systemjs/dist/system.src.js node_modules/tachyons/css/tachyons.css node_modules/mithril/mithril.js node_modules/lz-string/libs/lz-string.js dist/source/lib/ && cp node_modules/fflate/umd/index.js dist/source/lib/fflate.js
scripts.copy-data: mkdir -p dist/source/data/media && cp data/*.wld data/*.json dist/source/data/ && cp data/media/* dist/source/data/media/
scripts.copy-resources: mkdir -p dist/source/resources && cp source/resources/*.png source/resources/*.ico dist/source/resources/
scripts.copy-resources-more: mkdir -p dist/source/resources && cp source/resources/*.png source/resources/*.ico source/resources/template.html dist/source/resources/
